paired_test: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on integer error-count differences; zeros omitted, method=auto, uncorrected; conditional on each trained checkpoint. No equivalence test.

paired_bits_per_trial.coded: n_frames * frame_info_bits from each result file

interpretation.purpose: Additional training replications and seed sensitivity; historical measurements retained.
interpretation.original_measurements: Numerical differences between training realizations alone do not establish that historical measurements were incorrect.
interpretation.causal_limit: Historical canonical RNG states are unknown; repeated seed IDs and changed environments prevent attributing all differences to initial seed alone.
interpretation.pooling: Do not pool protocols or repeated seed IDs as independent new training seeds.

canonical_native.design: Additional training realization; historical RNG state unavailable, not an isolated seed-only experiment.

canonical_3k.design: Additional training realization; historical RNG state unavailable, not an isolated seed-only experiment.

sequence_memory.design: Repeated multi-seed study, grouped by execution environment; repeated seed IDs are not independent new seeds.

coded_matched.design: Additional same-protocol replication with the same declared local seed policy, not a new initial-seed sweep.

same_host_control.scope: Native MLP only; full original budget; same host/environment; new declared seed42.

limits: Historical canonical Torch states/checkpoints are absent. Seeded sequence/coded discrepancies remain unexplained; they cannot be attributed to missing canonical Torch seeding alone. Fixed-checkpoint paired tests do not measure training-population uncertainty. Minimum-size training grid, pilot studies, adaptive tails and matched Mamba were not rerun.
